description: Semantic chunking methods compared on the datasets under 5M cl100k tokens (ConditionalQA 1.05M, Natural Questions 2.60M, Qasper 2.12M, SQuAD 0.71M, TechQA 2.22M), the other stages at the README's baseline: no augmentation, bge-m3, dense retrieval, no reranking. They embed every sentence, so PoQuAD (7.06M), TriviaQA (6.39M) and GutenQA (15.66M) are left out. Run: .venv\Scripts\python.exe experiments.py experiments/semantic_chunking_eval.json

chunk_embedding.description: Over-long chunks (semantic chunking has no upper bound) are cut to bge-m3's limit, counted with its own tokenizer.
